title: CBDC-PDS Pilots — Twin Digital-Rupee Food-Subsidy Schemes Launched
summary: India launches two parallel CBDC (central bank digital sovereign currency) food-subsidy pilots: Gujarat Digital Food Coupon (Annapurti ATMs) and Puducherry PMGKAY e-Rupee token.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 CBDC-PDS Pilots — Twin Digital-Rupee Food-Subsidy Schemes Launched. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: India initiated two distinct CBDC (central bank digital sovereign currency)-based food-subsidy pilots: **Gujarat** (Digital Food Coupon with 'Annapurti' Grain ATMs) and **Puducherry** (PMGKAY programmable e-Rupee token with Canara Bank).
**Gujarat Pilot**: Inaugurated by Amit Shah; covers Gandhinagar, Ahmedabad, Surat, Anand, Valsad; Annapurti ATMs disburse 25 kg grain in 35 seconds.
**Puducherry Pilot**: Inaugurated by Pralhad Joshi; programmable e-Rupee tokens redeemed at Fair Price Shops.
